Hi Samir / Priya 1

Thanks again for the call today 1 great context on ACME's priority use cases (multi-document summarization + retriever shortlisting) and the success criteria you laid out. To keep momentum, recap and proposed next steps below.

Success criteria (as discussed):
- Functional: Redwood-generated summaries match or exceed baseline precision on the 50-sample prompt set you shared (target: >85% relevancy per your eval rubric).
- Performance: 95th percentile latency < 450ms for single-doc prompts in hosted trial; for larger combined-doc workloads we want throughput to sustain X QPS in your dedicated sandbox (we'll validate).
- Cost: Demonstrate per-request cost below your current vendor by at least 20% (ballpark metric for evaluation).
- Security/Controls: Logs, retention settings, and network isolation (VPC) validated for SOC2-relevant controls.

POC plan (proposed):
1) Week 0: Kickoff + NDA (if needed) and MUP (attached)
2) Week 1: Hosted quickstart (Redwood hosted API) 1 functional validation and prompt tuning with your sample dataset
3) Week 22: Dedicated sandbox or VPC trial (depending on your preference) 1 performance and integration testing with larger batches and KV/cache behavior
4) Week 3: Final evaluation demo + decision meeting

Request from your side to start:
- Confirm which environment you want to prioritize first (hosted quickstart vs go straight to VPC sandbox).
- Provide tech contact for network allowlist and sample dataset (links or s3 path).
- Any regulatory constraints (data residency or blocking of hosted environments).

Owners on our side: Marissa (sales/coordination), Dev (infrastructure lead), Lauren (CS/enablement). Attached: ACME_Mutual_Action_Plan_v1.pdf and redwood-poc-checklist.xlsx.

If that all looks good I can put calendar invites on Wed/Thu for a Week 0 kickoff.

Thanks 1
Marissa

FYI 1 technical notes / sandbox checklist for Marissa & ACME:

Hosted quickstart (week 1):
- Redwood hosted API: we provide API key, scoped retention 2472 hours (can be adjusted). No infra changes required on ACME side.
- Sample payloads: prefer S3 link to the 50-sample set or a shared Drive. Please include representative prompt length / avg token counts.

VPC sandbox (week 23):
Option A (ACME-managed VPC):
- We'll provide a CloudFormation/Terraform template to deploy Redwood sandbox components into your account. Needs: VPC/subnet, route table, NAT/IGW if required, and an SSM role for infra bootstrapping.
- Network allowlist: provide a CIDR or static IP range; we'll give you the endpoint IPs to allow.
- Expected runtime: small GPU instance for perf testing is optional (we can start on CPU-backed instances for basic validation).

Option B (Redwood-managed isolated VPC):
- We spin up an isolated VPC in our AWS account and share peering/endpoint details. Faster but some customers ask for ACME-managed for policy reasons.

Checklist for integration testing:
- Provide sample dataset + eval rubric (ACME)
- Provide allowlist and an infra contact (ACME)
- Confirm retention / logging policy (ACME)
- Confirm expected QPS and average tokens per request

I'll prepare the poc-env-specs.md (attached) with exact commands, IAM policy snippets, and an estimator for expected GPU/RAM sizing based on sample token distributions. For the hosted quickstart there is no procurement step; for VPC/dedicated, procurement may be needed if ACME requests reserved capacity.
